amenityCountModel.interpretation: a conditional association of the count, NOT the legacy interaction claim: the legacy 'combined effect exceeds the sum of individual effects' is a SHAP-interaction output of the retired model and is withdrawn, not re-expressed here
amenityCountModel.regressor: amenity_count = number of the five indicators equal to 1 (integer 0-5), continuous in log points per additional amenity type within 1000 m; same controls and sample

controls: lease_commence_date (calendar year of lease commencement, continuous)
storey midpoint ((storey_min + storey_max)/2, storey number, continuous)
town fixed effects (levels observed in the sample; baseline ANG MO KIO)
transaction-year fixed effects (baseline 2015; absorb nominal price drift and inflation)
estimator.functionalForm: log-linear; coefficients are log points, and pctEffectExpMinus1 = 100*(exp(beta)-1) is the approximate percentage difference the log point implies
estimator.indicators: each amenity enters as dist <= 1000 m in the shipped snapshot feature; ALL five indicators are fitted jointly in ONE specification (no selection, no stepwise search)
estimator.internalScaling: floor_area_sqm/10, (lease_commence_date-2000)/10 and storey midpoint/10 for numerical stability; the amenity indicators and dummies are unscaled, and the control coefficients below are back-transformed to natural units
estimator.name: OLS (statsmodels OLS, HC1 heteroskedasticity-robust covariance, use_t=False)
notControlled: flat_model (unit layout vintage; many levels, not in the legacy controls either)
unit condition, renovation, view and floor orientation
block-level attributes (point blocks, lift upgrading, car park)
buyer grants, ethnicity-quota constraints and financing conditions
walking-path distance, street-level connectivity, and amenity quality or operating status
town x year shocks (amenity indicators correlate with neighbourhood change inside a town)
the amenity snapshot's own vintage (see snapshotJoinMismatch)
estimator.remainingLeaseEquivalence: remaining lease at transaction = 99 - (transaction year - lease commencement year) for 99-year resale flats; given the transaction-year fixed effects, lease_commence_date and that remaining-lease measure are affine transforms of each other, so the two parameterisations are equivalent here
estimator.response: log(resale price), resale price in nominal Singapore dollars (SGD)
estimator.standardErrors: HC1 robust; no clustering (town and year enter as fixed effects, not clusters)

sample.cutoffUpperBoundMeaning: every model row and every aggregate in this ledger ends at the last complete month; the terminal partial month is excluded
sample.reasonSetSemantics: exclusions are sets: a row failing several conditions records every reason (excludedRowsByReasonCount counts rows by the SIZE of their reason set), and no reason is asserted as the single cause

supermarketContrast.note: the supermarket indicator equals 0 for 0.42% of the sample, so its coefficient is a near-degenerate contrast and its sign must not be read as an amenity effect; the group is attributed here

condoScope.statement: no condo model is fitted: the private-residential source starts 2021-01, so the legacy amenity statements' 2015-2026 span has no condo analogue, and no cross-segment comparison is measured; counts are separated per side of the window so the terminal partial month is never mixed into a coverage count

cutoff.basis: last complete month = the month before the terminal month, whose transaction count is a measured fraction of the trailing-12-month median, not an assumed calendar fact

definition: A descriptive conditional-association refit: one recorded OLS of log(HDB resale price in SGD) on five jointly-fitted snapshot amenity indicators (shipped distance <= 1000 m) with stated controls (floor area sqm, lease commencement year, storey midpoint, flat-type/town/transaction-year fixed effects) and HC1 robust standard errors, plus an amenity-count model. Coefficients are conditional associations in a cross-section, not premiums and not causal effects; the amenity features come from one snapshot per layer whose datedness differs (update stamps from 2021-12 to 2026-01 where they exist; hawker completion dates are the only presence dates, and supermarkets, preschools, malls and MRT carry none) and is joined to transactions from 2015 onward, so no coefficient compares amenity states at two dates; no temporal model, no feature-importance model and no interaction model is reproduced. This ledger records one specification and only that one was fitted, and all its coefficients are reported; there is no dated prior protocol, so specification search cannot be ruled out — the single-specification discipline is a disclosed limitation, not a credential.

scope: RS04 amenity-impact evidence: amenity-source vintages, shipped-feature lineage with a targeted leave-out ablation, the measured hawker snapshot-join mismatch, and a descriptive conditional-association refit with stated units and controls (one recorded specification; no dated prior protocol, so specification search cannot be ruled out)

shippedFeatureLineage.grain: every unique (lat, lon) location in the study window (not a sample)

hawker.conclusion: the shipped dist_to_nearest_hawker reproduces exactly from the bronze snapshot that INCLUDES the six Under-Construction centres; a targeted ablation excluding them breaks reproduction for every location whose nearest centre is one of those six (and none of the others), so those six centres' coordinates feed the single distance value the location join applies to transactions of every study month. When construction at each site began is not recorded in this checkout

mall.conclusion: the shipped dist_to_nearest_mall reproduces exactly from the 294-row MP25 bronze frame; its nearest-name column is empty for every row because the MP25 layer carries no names

shippedFeatureLineage.method: nearest-POI metres recomputed with the pipeline's own estimator (BallTree(metric='haversine') k=1, radians x 6371000) from the sha-pinned bronze frames, compared to the shipped columns at 1e-6 m tolerance

mrt.conclusion: the shipped dist_to_nearest_mrt reproduces exactly from the 188-row undated bronze station frame at this location grain, consistent with RS03's sample-level lineage measurement

shippedFeatureLineage.notRecomputed: park and supermarket lineage is not recomputed here; their bronze frames are audited in amenityVintages and their snapshot-join mismatch is not measurable (no dated vintage)

shippedFeatures.grain: computed once per unique (lat, lon) location and left-merged onto transactions (features.py builds the location dimension on ~10K unique locations, not per transaction)

notMeasurableForOtherAmenities.mall: the MP25 layer carries no dates and its raw GeoJSON is not in this checkout
notMeasurableForOtherAmenities.meaning: the join applies one snapshot's values to transactions of every month, so the mismatch is present by construction; its magnitude is not measurable in this checkout
notMeasurableForOtherAmenities.mrt: no opening dates (bronze); one 2019-12-09 seed stamp (RS03)
notMeasurableForOtherAmenities.park: no gazetting or opening date; only a 2026-01-15 update stamp
notMeasurableForOtherAmenities.preschool: no date property of any kind
notMeasurableForOtherAmenities.supermarket: no date property of any kind; outlet vintages cannot be reconstructed

snapshotJoinMismatch.rule: each transaction's nearest hawker centre (by exact bronze name) is classified against EST_ORIGINAL_COMPLETION_DATE: an exact date at or before the transaction month's first day counts as completed; a year-only value strictly before the transaction year counts as completed, a year-only value in the transaction year is NOT established as completed (mid-year completion is unresolved, a conservative reading); a future-year value (all six Under Construction centres) is not established for any study transaction; pre-war counts as completed; null/unknown stays unknown. Centres farther than the nearest are not classified.

withinAreaVariation.grainNote: the shipped dataset carries both town and planning_area and they disagree (e.g. town KALLANG/WHAMPOA spans planning areas KALLANG and NOVENA), so both grains are measured
withinAreaVariation.note: presence dispersion only: no premium is computed per area, no grid is built, and variation in an indicator is not variation in a premium. The legacy analysis' within-town regressions (minimum 100 transactions per town) and 500m grid cells (minimum 5 records) are retired-model constructs and are not reproduced.
